summary.story: The Legend of Hei II (simplified Chinese: 罗小黑战记2; traditional Chinese: 羅小黑戰記2; pinyin: Luóxiǎohēizhànjì2) is a 2025 Chinese animated action adventure film written and directed by MTJJ and Gu Jie. It was released in theaters across China on July 18, 2025. The film is the sequel to The Legend of Hei (2019).
